decisions.decision: Lead model, provider and reasoning route
decisions.observe: `routes.list` returns the routes configured in `host.json` that the mod may see
decisions.alter: no partial edit; a configured route is selected whole
decisions.timing: thread creation, and per request through `model_request` among lead routes on the same provider
decisions.ownership: mod: which configured route; host: the route table, grants, billing and admission
decisions.limits: only configured routes; an unknown or unauthorized name keeps the configured model; arbitrary models, endpoints or credentials are never reachable
decisions.native: native plugins and hooks cannot change model, provider or reasoning effort

decisions.decision: Mod-initiated agents and isolated integration
decisions.observe: `agents.list`, `agents.result`, `agents.wait` and `task.status` report the caller's agents and the session ledger
decisions.alter: `agents.message` steers a running agent; `agents.cancel` stops it
decisions.timing: any tool, command or lifecycle callback with a live session
decisions.ownership: mod: role, prompt, route, tool ceiling and when to integrate; host: sandbox, worktree, worker limits, accounting and the integrate gate
decisions.limits: worker routes need a current grant; at most 16 records; a writable agent works only in an isolated worktree; integration refuses stale parents, changed candidates and an unmet `integrate` contract gate; optional parent_history requires sessions; failed results retain structured host categories; explicit resume preserves task allowance but never agent handles
decisions.native: native subagents cannot be spawned, limited or integrated by a plugin or hook

decisions.decision: Completion and integration contract
decisions.observe: `contract.status` returns the selected document, provenance, receipts and restrictions
decisions.alter: `contract.restrict` only narrows operations; `receipts.submit` adds host-attested receipts; scoped argument predicates can only tighten selected operations; `contract.select` writes the user selection after a native confirmation
decisions.timing: selection at session start; gates at `task.complete` and `workspace.integrate`
decisions.ownership: mod: registers documents and submits receipts; user: selects the document; host: digest pinning, project floor, producer attestation and the gate
decisions.limits: no selection means no gate; an unavailable or changed selection fails closed; a weaker selection needs an exact confirmation; a mod can only ask the user through `contract.select`, whose native confirmation names any lowered assurance
decisions.native: native plugins and hooks have no completion gate

decisions.decision: Local model providers
decisions.observe: `routes.list` shows the provider route once ready
decisions.alter: none
decisions.timing: start, resume and turn start
decisions.ownership: mod: registers a granted local provider; host: the grant, loopback address, readiness handshake and accounting
decisions.limits: only a provider granted in `host.json` for that mod; loopback only; unregistered on disable or failure
decisions.native: native plugins can add MCP servers but not model providers

decisions.decision: Request ledger
decisions.observe: `task.status` and the `ledger` field of `context` and `terminal` events
decisions.alter: none
decisions.timing: every request
decisions.ownership: host: observes every lead and native sub-agent request; enforces limits on mod agents and on a lead whose model matches a configured lead route with rates
decisions.limits: observation never blocks an unenforced request; enforced requests are admitted, reserved and settled
decisions.native: native hooks cannot see requests or usage

decisions.decision: Model request, stream and session interception
decisions.observe: `prompt`, `session`, `agent`, `tool_call` and `host_operation` middleware observe in order; `model_response` reports every provider attempt and synthetic answer with usage, cache, cost basis and timing
decisions.alter: `intercept('model_request')` changes the route among the thread's lead routes (another provider only with its own credential), the reasoning effort and ordinary prompt sections, or answers with a synthetic response that calls no provider; `intercept('response_stream')` rewrites or drops text and tool-call chunks, adds chunks and may stop only at an output boundary, with an optional retry; `intercept('host_operation')` wraps mod host calls made outside interceptor callbacks, except session and evidence reads, under the caller's grants; `host_operation` inputs carry the typed `namespace` and `origin`
decisions.timing: per request, per streamed chunk and per settled attempt
decisions.ownership: mod: the transformation or synthetic answer; host: protected sections, opaque reasoning, admission, settlement, boundaries, retry limit and provenance
decisions.limits: protected sections and reasoning/stop chunks are observe-only; inserted sections are framed as mod context; synthetic answers carry no usage; stop only at a completed item; at most two retries per turn
decisions.native: the native transport, accounting and policy floors run on the effective request

decisions.decision: Final-request policy over the exact provider-bound body
decisions.observe: `intercept('model_send')` pages every non-empty text leaf of the body each lead, worker, completion, fork and internal request sends, after every editable wrapper and host edit, with opaque values named
decisions.alter: policies return range edits that keep the edits beneath them, or deny; the host re-checks changed text until no policy edits it
decisions.timing: per provider attempt, before the request is admitted and sent
decisions.ownership: mod: detection, edits and refusal reasons; host: segment walk, paging, edit validation, verdict reuse, fixed point, fail-closed refusal, declared policies and unsupported-transport refusal
decisions.limits: 256 edits of 4 KiB per page; 96 KiB encoded text per page and 128 pages per request; policy floors, reasoning, tool specs and schemas deny-only; images, audio, files and encrypted reasoning are opaque, listed media first up to 256 with `opaque_total`; `cache: false` opts a page out of verdict reuse
decisions.native: the native transport sends only the checked body; records keep digests and the transcript keeps the original

decisions.decision: Host-routed namespaced and versioned service contracts between mods
decisions.observe: installed contract types and status name provider, consumer, exact version, method, scope and generation
decisions.alter: a consumer supplies only the declared bounded JSON input and receives a schema-kind-checked result
decisions.timing: providers, consumers, versions, collisions and dependency order resolve before activation; calls run through the host during a callback
decisions.ownership: host: provider lookup, capability separation, input/output bounds, generation ownership, call provenance and unload cleanup
decisions.limits: no shared globals, state, secrets, filesystem, network, process authority or inherited grants; optional absence is catchable while required absence, incompatibility, cycles and collisions fail before activation
decisions.native: no equivalent typed inter-plugin service contract in configured Codex hooks
evidence: node:typed middleware and services register without ambient authority

decisions.decision: Mod context block added to each native context assembly
decisions.observe: `on('context')` contributes a bounded fragment
decisions.alter: fragments compose in activation order under one aggregate limit
decisions.timing: every native turn-context assembly, lead thread only
decisions.ownership: host: user/project instructions, native mandatory context, ordering and the aggregate budget
decisions.limits: 1 KiB per fragment, 6 KiB aggregate; mod context is always subordinate developer context and names its mod
decisions.native: `session_start`/`user_prompt_submit` hooks can inject additional context, but there is no exclusive assembler and no declared ordering
decisions.replace_note: the exclusive assembler; observer fragments are dropped with a visible notice

decisions.decision: Submitted prompt: transform or deny
decisions.observe: `intercept('input')` with the thread, text and attachment count
decisions.alter: pass rewritten text to `next`, or return `{deny}`; interceptors compose in continuation order
decisions.timing: before native prompt hooks, skill/mention resolution and history, in TUI and exec
decisions.ownership: host: submission path, attachments, history and the visible notice
decisions.limits: a rewrite or denial is always shown to the user; attachments are retained; a handler returns only what `next` returned or `{deny}`, so it cannot bypass an inner required interceptor
decisions.native: `user_prompt_submit` hooks can block a prompt or add context; competing rewrites are resolved by whichever hook finishes last
evidence: node:lifecycle events and interceptors require their capabilities

decisions.decision: Automatic compaction threshold and local summarization prompt
decisions.observe: the host token limit and context window
decisions.alter: threshold within host bounds
decisions.timing: thread creation and resume
decisions.ownership: host: the compaction engine, the window and remote-compaction behaviour
decisions.limits: 256 tokens to the host ceiling; the prompt applies only to native local compaction, remote compaction keeps native behaviour with a visible diagnostic
decisions.native: `pre_compact`/`post_compact` hooks observe and can add context; they cannot set the threshold or the prompt

decisions.decision: Session and turn lifecycle observation
decisions.observe: start, resume, idle, stop, tool_result, turn_start, turn_end, compaction_start, compaction_end, agent_end
decisions.alter: not alterable
decisions.timing: at each native lifecycle point, lead thread only
decisions.ownership: host: cancellation, turn cleanup and ordering
decisions.limits: observers cannot run host operations, cannot delay the turn past their budget, and cannot intercept cancellation
decisions.native: hooks cover session_start/end, stop, interrupt and subagent start/stop with comparable observation

decisions.decision: Durable per-mod data and evidence
decisions.observe: `store.get`, `store.list` and `evidence.read` read the caller's namespace
decisions.alter: `store.put`/`store.delete` with the current revision; `store.reset` with the current generation; `evidence.write` stores content-addressed evidence; `api.state` per mod store, session thread or Git checkout through the manifest `state_scope`; experimental `api.uiState` is terminal-capability session/package-scoped ephemeral data, with revision checks, a 64 KiB bound, command/component-event writes and cleanup on reload, revoke and exit
decisions.timing: any callback; `migrate` on a state-version change
decisions.ownership: mod: keys and values; host: namespaces, revisions, provenance, bounds and export
decisions.limits: 256-byte keys, 256 KiB values, 16 MiB and 4,096 keys per scope; stale revisions fail; no cross-mod reads; `api.state` 64 KiB per mod store or 192 KiB per thread or checkout, compare-and-swap writes retried at most twice by replaying recorded host results; general callbacks reactivate in fresh VM contexts even when sandboxed processes and bounded compilation caches are reused; module globals do not persist between general callbacks
decisions.native: native hooks hold no state between invocations

decisions.decision: Session history and turn evidence
decisions.observe: `sessions.list` and `sessions.read` page visible messages, tool calls and tool results; `sessions.snapshot` freezes complete visible current-thread tool history or selected call/output pairs; `turn_end` carries turn evidence
decisions.alter: none
decisions.timing: any callback; turn evidence at turn end
decisions.ownership: host: repository scope, opt-outs, redaction and bounds
decisions.limits: Snapshots require sessions and store, omit private reasoning and opaque metadata, and refuse missing call/output pairs or oversized history; all evidence remains owner, source and thread bound
decisions.native: native hooks see only the current payload

decisions.decision: Deferred mod tools offered to the model
decisions.observe: the model's arguments
decisions.alter: the tool's own result
decisions.timing: registered at activation; ordinary tools are callable for the whole generation
decisions.ownership: host: the executor, permissions, deadlines, accounting and the tool lifecycle
decisions.limits: 16 tools per mod, namespaced `mod_<id>_<name>`, 8 KiB schema validated by the native tool registry
decisions.native: native plugins add tools only through MCP servers, as a separate process with its own transport

decisions.decision: Task-scoped exposure of optional mod tools
decisions.observe: only the current host checkpoint, thread ID and the mod's own optional tool names
decisions.alter: select a subset of the mod's own task-scoped tools for one sampling step
decisions.timing: after host task state is available and before each step's tool registry is built
decisions.ownership: host: the native tool registry, all other tools, permissions, accounting and callback failure containment
decisions.limits: new API .8 only; a missing, invalid or failed decision exposes no optional tools; an unselected tool is not registered for that step, and a mod cannot name another package's or native tools
decisions.native: Codex has per-step native tool contributors and configured MCP/plugin filtering; no public TypeScript mod choice over its own per-step optional tools existed

decisions.decision: Tool call continuation: transform, retarget, deny, answer, hold, retry or invoke
decisions.observe: `intercept('tool')` with the tool, arguments, call, thread, agent, schema and batch position; `next` resolves to the executed result
decisions.alter: pass a changed tool or arguments to `next`, return `{deny}`, transform the result, answer without running the tool, call `next` again to retry, or run and assess other tools with `tools.invoke` and `tools.check`
decisions.timing: before native hooks and permission checks; the result returns after the handler and before upstream truncation
decisions.ownership: host: permissions, the executor and completion evidence
decisions.limits: the effective call, each retry and each `tools.invoke` re-enter native permissions, approvals, sandbox and accounting under their own call id; `tools.check` asks each tool's runtime and the approval middleware (as an assessment) without running or prompting; a synthetic answer is recorded as `answered_by` and cannot forge completion evidence; a mod never intercepts its own invoked call
decisions.native: `pre_tool_use` blocks or rewrites input; the last-finishing hook silently wins a contested rewrite, no hook can retarget the call or answer it

decisions.decision: Slash commands and their results
decisions.observe: the argument text
decisions.alter: display, insert or submit text
decisions.timing: outside native tasks, from the CLI, the `/` popup or a keybinding
decisions.ownership: host: the submission path, queueing and command precedence
decisions.limits: 16 per mod; namespaced `/<id>:<name>` always exists, a bare alias only when unique; submitted text uses the native path with no shell escape; host operations that need a task fail with `host_operation_unavailable`
decisions.native: plugins contribute prompt-style slash commands, not code-backed commands with structured results

decisions.decision: Streamed progress and the transcript activity line
decisions.observe: not applicable
decisions.alter: up to 32 bounded progress updates per tool call
decisions.timing: during a mod tool call only
decisions.ownership: host: rendering, the live progress panel and the completed activity line
decisions.limits: 1 KiB per update; forwarded once across host-call replay; refused outside a tool callback
decisions.native: hooks can show a status message; there is no streaming progress channel

decisions.decision: Versioned reads supplied by extensions
decisions.observe: Public API 0.2 operation results and owner-scoped events
decisions.alter: Extension-owned selection and interpretation within host grants
decisions.timing: Inside the documented callback or explicitly dispatched plugin command
decisions.ownership: The extension parses its namespace and retrieves content; the host routes the common read tool, binds provider source and provenance, and prevents remote resources from impersonating local files.
decisions.limits: Reserved and colliding schemes fail closed; 16 KiB pages; continuation requires exact revision; handlers can only read workspace files or invoke a granted service.
decisions.native: Pinned Codex does not expose this OMD public extension contract

decisions.decision: One-shot sandboxed commands
decisions.observe: the result reports exit status, bounded output, timing, captured stdout digest and the program hash; snapshot commands return candidate-bound host execution evidence
decisions.alter: `sha256` pins the program; `write`, `network` and `unix_sockets` widen only with `fs.write`, `network` and `unix_sockets`; guarded writes recheck bounded command output and named path access under the host operation guard
decisions.timing: any tool, command or lifecycle callback
decisions.ownership: mod: program and arguments; host: resolution, sandbox, environment, limits and cancellation
decisions.limits: 10 s default and 120 s ceiling; 1 MiB per stream normally, or a complete UTF-8 stdout artifact up to 16 MiB with 16 KiB bound pages; artifacts are bound to the same repository, mod source and thread and capped at 64 MiB per binding; 4 concurrent runs; declared environment names only; at most 4 Unix sockets, each named by a declared variable whose host value is a canonical user-owned socket outside the repository; read-only repository without `write`; at most 4 read-only command guards and 128 required write-access paths; selected snapshots are frozen, source changes are refused, and successful execution receipts require zero exit without timeout, signal or truncated output
decisions.native: native hooks run commands outside the session sandbox

decisions.decision: Workspace reads, listings, preconditioned writes and changes
decisions.observe: `workspace.read`, `workspace.list`, `workspace.stat`, `workspace.check_access` and `workspace_change` within the session's effective permission scope; workspace.snapshot captures an owner-bound frozen candidate
decisions.alter: `workspace.transaction`, `workspace.backup`, `workspace.restore` and `workspace.request_rename` with exact preconditions
decisions.timing: tools; lifecycle events; `workspace_pre_rename` during a requested rename
decisions.ownership: mod: paths and contents; host: permissions, preconditions, atomic replacement, backups and change scans
decisions.limits: stale fingerprints fail; `.git` and symlinks are refused; transactions and restores are exclusive per repository within the host; scans are bounded and report `unavailable` instead of partial coverage
decisions.native: native hooks can rewrite a tool's input but not perform checked multi-file writes

decisions.decision: Long-lived framed processes
decisions.observe: `process.status` reports liveness and idle time
decisions.alter: `process.exchange` sends and receives framed messages
decisions.timing: tools and lifecycle events
decisions.ownership: mod: program and protocol; host: program identity, sandbox, framing, bounds and cleanup
decisions.limits: content-length or NDJSON framing, or raw stdout and stderr chunks; loopback only with `network`; sessions end with the mod generation, disable or thread stop
decisions.native: native MCP servers are fixed at startup and not owned by a mod

decisions.decision: Explicitly granted unsandboxed processes
decisions.observe: `sandbox: "none"` on `exec.run`, `process.start` and PTY starts returns the same results as the sandboxed paths
decisions.alter: run `os_access.programs` with the user's filesystem, outside-workspace working directories and, when `os_access.network` is true, external network
decisions.timing: any callback that may run the sandboxed operation, inside a current grant without a per-call prompt
decisions.ownership: user: the hash-bound `os` grant, its expiry and `omd-mod revoke`; host: program scope, sanitized environment, limits, cancellation, process-group teardown on revoke, reload or disable
decisions.limits: no host credentials, secret variables or secrets API; children run as the user and can read user-readable secret files and change mod stores; only the OS-separated broker protects grants, credentials and evidence anchors; guards, Unix sockets, loopback and snapshots need the sandbox
decisions.native: no native equivalent

decisions.decision: Granted sidecars and service requests
decisions.observe: `sidecars.status` reports liveness
decisions.alter: `sidecars.invoke` sends one bounded request
decisions.timing: tools and lifecycle events
decisions.ownership: mod: when to start and call; host: the grant, program hash, secrets, sandbox and cleanup
decisions.limits: only services granted in `host.json` for that mod; responses are untrusted and bounded; secrets never appear in responses
decisions.native: native plugins can start MCP servers but not supervised, hash-pinned sidecars

decisions.decision: Built-in commands and collaboration modes
decisions.observe: the registry snapshot lists hidden commands and disabled modes
decisions.alter: `api.builtins` hides commands and disables modes
decisions.timing: registered at activation; applied at the next idle boundary; restored on disable, unload or failure
decisions.ownership: mod: which built-ins; host: protected recovery commands and the default mode
decisions.limits: `/omd`, `/quit`, `/exit`, `/approvals`, `/permissions`, `/status`, `/logout` and the default mode cannot be removed; a disabled mode is clamped to default at turn start with a warning
decisions.native: native plugins cannot remove built-in commands or modes

decisions.decision: Code-mode kernels and package adapters
decisions.observe: the `kernel` tool lists configured kernels
decisions.alter: configuration adds kernels; an adapter package wraps a dependent package before activation
decisions.timing: worker start; package activation
decisions.ownership: user: kernel configuration; adapter author: the wrapper; host: driver hashes and capability containment
decisions.limits: a changed driver refuses to start; an adapted package keeps only its own capabilities
decisions.native: native plugins cannot add execution kernels or API adapters

decisions.decision: Terminal view composed from every mod's patch
decisions.observe: the triggering event, checkpoint, real version/installed identity and host presentation phase fresh/started/resumed
decisions.alter: every mod returns a bounded patch; patches wrap or replace declared sites and add presentation fields, and exclusive fields go to the first mod in composition order
decisions.timing: repeatable startup presentation before the first editable frame, then every mod event; redrawn inline and fullscreen
decisions.ownership: host: driver, layout, modes, validation, native composer, recovery, input primitives and restoration
decisions.limits: dependency order is deterministic; later claims on exclusive fields are reported in `terminal.conflicts` and invalid patches fail alone and transactionally; only the current experimental API loads; title suffix and greeting are bounded last-writer scalars; the welcome site uses blank space only and never restores after an accepted start or resume; recovery remains native
decisions.native: native plugins cannot change the terminal at all

decisions.decision: Declarative components at sidebar, header, above-composer, dialog and welcome sites
decisions.observe: not applicable
decisions.alter: bounded box, text, button, input, select, Markdown, code, pane and dialog trees; wrappers expose exactly one slot
decisions.timing: fullscreen, with inline fallbacks
decisions.ownership: host: focus, scroll, redraw, pointer and keyboard dispatch, resize, accessibility labels, clipboard and the native inspector
decisions.limits: 64 components per site, depth 6, unique bounded IDs and labels; narrow fallbacks apply; controls, raw escapes and arbitrary widgets are rejected
decisions.native: no equivalent

decisions.decision: Palettes, semantic diff/status tones, borders, density, icons and syntax theme
decisions.observe: not applicable
decisions.alter: bounded named theme slots and presentation variants
decisions.timing: inline and fullscreen
decisions.ownership: host: the terminal colour depth and the configured theme
decisions.limits: 256-colour index or `#rrggbb` mapped to terminal depth; no-color drops custom colors, ASCII uses plain borders, there is no mod animation, and removal restores native presentation
decisions.native: no equivalent

decisions.decision: Generic surface gradients and transformed image/ASCII backdrops
decisions.observe: not applicable
decisions.alter: `surface_styles` for composer/backdrop/approval framing; backdrop placement, scale, offset, dim, opacity, tint and image overlay paint
decisions.timing: inline or owned viewport render; media cached until resource, transform, environment or geometry changes
decisions.ownership: mod: colors, composition and contrast policy; host: bounded decode/render and native text/semantic preservation
decisions.limits: scale 0.1-4, offsets -4096..4096 cells, dim/opacity 0-1, RGB or indexed colors; no-color drops styling; graphics only detected local Kitty protocol in owned viewport; ASCII/plain-color fallback; decorative backdrops omitted below 60 columns, solid colors retained
decisions.native: hooks cannot style terminal surfaces

decisions.decision: F2-F12, Ctrl/Alt actions and component interaction
decisions.observe: not applicable
decisions.alter: insert, submit, run a command, focus a component, activate a control, or request native clipboard copy
decisions.timing: inline and fullscreen while the mod view is active
decisions.ownership: host: native keymap, modal input, focus, pointer dispatch, clipboard authorization and cancellation keys
decisions.limits: Ctrl, Alt and Shift combinations of letters, digits, F2–F12 and named keys; active native bindings and chords win with a visible notice; Escape, Ctrl+C/D/Z/H/I/J/M, Shift+Tab and cancellation remain native
decisions.native: no equivalent

decisions.decision: Render hooks on native components
decisions.observe: typed props, stable identity, surface, viewport and lifecycle of each user and assistant message, agent tool row (shell, grouped reads, patch, web search, agent, MCP, dynamic and image calls with status, output summary and whether the user expanded it), MCP result, spinner, turn duration, notice, session mode, composer hint, question and list
decisions.alter: `api.intercept('render', …)` restyles the native drawing (`{type: 'native', style}`), wraps it in a component tree, replaces or hides it (`{tree: []}`), and may rewrite spinner `header`, notice `text`, session-mode `label` and composer `placeholder` through `next`; `inline_sites: 'hidden'` keeps sites out of the inline viewport
decisions.timing: live components redraw asynchronously and keep their last tree until the new answer arrives; inline scrollback waits once per cell; trees are cached until the state keys their hooks read change
decisions.ownership: host: the raw transcript, approval overlays, question answers, keys, focus and stored messages
decisions.limits: presentation only; render callbacks get no host operations or state writes; a failing hook falls back to what it received; approval identity, options and grants stay native
decisions.native: no equivalent

decisions.decision: Launch identity, styled header lines and width-bounded boxes
decisions.observe: the read-only `identity` on the terminal input: installed Codex version, install profile, effective mode and installed, enabled and active mod counts
decisions.alter: a `line` of styled spans and `box` width bounds
decisions.timing: every terminal redraw on the alternate screen, including Codex's owned fullscreen transcript
decisions.ownership: host: identity values, width fitting and header height; mod: presentation choice
decisions.limits: 12 spans and 256 characters per line; widths 1-500; no mod identity or presentation in upstream-style direct mode
decisions.native: native plugins cannot draw terminal presentation
decisions.replace_note: presentation fields in the terminal view or patch

decisions.decision: One box model for components and host chrome; content centred in the area panes leave
decisions.observe: none
decisions.alter: a `style` (border, padding, margin, gap, background, foreground, row or column direction, hover and focus accents) on `box`, `pane`, `dialog`, overlays, layout site leaves and `sidebar_style`; `flex` and width bounds on boxes and panes; `gap` on splits
decisions.timing: every terminal redraw; hover restyles on pointer motion without component events
decisions.ownership: host: geometry, border glyphs, ASCII fallback, hit regions and centring the logo, welcome and dialogs in the chat area; mod: presentation choice
decisions.limits: padding, margin and gaps 0-4; flex 1-12; accents never add or remove a border; render hook trees refuse `style` and `flex`
decisions.native: native plugins cannot draw terminal presentation
decisions.replace_note: presentation fields in the terminal view or patch

decisions.decision: Built-in lists, insert, placeholder and glyphs
decisions.observe: none
decisions.alter: components may `{insert}` text; a `render` hook on component `list` draws the rows and their surroundings; a view may set `placeholder` and width-preserving `theme.glyphs`
decisions.timing: on render
decisions.ownership: mod: rows and spans; host: keyboard handling, selection, the chosen action and width checks
decisions.limits: search input keeps native rendering; width-changing glyphs are ignored
decisions.native: native plugins cannot restyle built-in pickers

decisions.decision: Controlled fields, component events and pane control
decisions.observe: `component_event` reports focus, blur, per-edit `change`, `scroll`, `pointer`, `open` and `close` with their origin to the component's owner only
decisions.alter: a changed `input`/`select` `value` resets the field while echoes of the user's own edits are ignored; `terminal.pane` opens, closes, focuses, scrolls or reveals the caller's own pane, dialog or control
decisions.timing: after each user gesture or pane request, off the input thread
decisions.ownership: mod: its own components; host: keys, focus ring, host-reserved keys and permission controls
decisions.limits: only the owner of a component receives its events or may move it; other mods' components and native views are out of reach
decisions.native: no equivalent

decisions.decision: Rich controls, notices, pane visibility and owner focus/scroll hooks
decisions.observe: `terminal.panes` lists the caller's own panes with visibility, collapse, focus and scroll; `component_event` reports a multiselect's checked `values`
decisions.alter: `terminal.notice` shows attributed toast, status or transcript notices with lifetimes, optional model audience and tool-call correlation; a `component_change` interceptor denies, redirects or clamps a user focus or scroll change on its own components; local user callbacks can read current selection or submit a bounded native clipboard copy with explicit delivery status
decisions.timing: notices and pane reads on request; `component_change` synchronously before the change is reported
decisions.ownership: mod: its own components, notices and queued context; host: notice attribution, link sanitizing, keys and focus ring
decisions.limits: 512-byte notices, 1–60 s lifetimes, 4 live per mod, 8 queued model notices per thread; http(s) links of 2,048 bytes; only the component's owner sees or answers its change
decisions.native: no equivalent

decisions.decision: Keyed rasters, pointer capture, overlays, Kitty image placement and client facts
decisions.observe: the `terminal` event carries `client` graphics, pointer, reduced-motion and cell-pixel facts; pointer components report `enter`, `leave`, `move`, `down`, `up` and `drag` with half-cell rows
decisions.alter: `terminal.blit` queues partial cell updates into the mod's own `raster`; named sites may be overlays anchored to the screen or a component with z-order and clipping
decisions.timing: one queued blit applied per 16 ms frame; newest image or raw-pixel frame replaces pending frames; latest-wins pointer motion; a press captures until release
decisions.ownership: mod: its own rasters, overlays and images; host: frame pacing, hit-testing layers, image ids and teardown
decisions.limits: rasters 200x40 cells, 16 per mod, 32 queued cell updates or 256 KiB; overlay z 0–9; encoded images 8 MiB and 4,096 px; raw RGB/RGBA 4,096 px per side (64 MiB maximum), one immutable newest frame per raster, process and generation scoped handles
decisions.native: no equivalent

decisions.decision: Reactive atoms, selectors and keyed subscriptions
decisions.observe: `api.atom`, `api.member` and `api.derive` read keys of an object `api.state`; render hooks report the keys they read
decisions.alter: `set`/`update` write through the same compare-and-swap state; `api.subscribe` runs once per changed atom after the handler that changed it
decisions.timing: subscribers run before the callback commits, so a lost compare-and-swap reruns them with it
decisions.ownership: mod: its own state; host: storage, compare-and-swap and render cache invalidation
decisions.limits: render callbacks cannot write state; subscriptions register during activation; at most 64 subscriptions and 8 cascade rounds per callback
decisions.native: no equivalent
evidence: node:reactive atoms track reads, recompute derived values and run keyed subscriptions once per change

decisions.decision: Pinned app-server requests and notifications
decisions.observe: `app_notification` and `app_server_request` for subscribed methods, with coalesced and dropped counts
decisions.alter: `app.request` sends a routed method; only each route's listed fields are accepted, and thread, root and model fields are checked
decisions.timing: user commands and event callbacks; turn-starting methods only from user contexts
decisions.ownership: mod: which routed method; host: the route table, per-method class, contexts, confirmation and thread scope
decisions.limits: only methods in `app.routes`; thread-scoped methods reach the current thread and threads the mod started or forked; local media paths are refused; `mcpServer/tool/call` is confirmed per call; confirmations show the exact parameters and refuse requests over 2,000 bytes; `config/read` redacts MCP server and model provider secret values and URL credentials; config writes reach writable keys and listed sub-keys only (`mcp_servers.<name>.enabled`, plugin enablement and tool lists); `command/exec`, `process/*`, `fs/*`, `thread/shellCommand` and credential flows are excluded; the in-process app-server only (`client_surface_unavailable` otherwise); 256 events / 1 MiB per mod queue
decisions.native: hooks cannot call the app-server or observe its notifications

decisions.decision: Approval middleware and results
decisions.observe: `approval` for exec, patch, MCP, network and permission requests; `approval_result` with the deciding source
decisions.alter: deny, `ask` to force the native prompt, or `approve` inside a user-delegated `approve` grant (kinds, tools, roots, hosts; `approve.override` for requests the user's own rules forbid)
decisions.timing: before hooks, automatic review and full-access shortcuts
decisions.ownership: mod: policy and delegated approvals inside its grant; host: grant checks, managed-policy floors, the decision, the prompt and the record
decisions.limits: any deny wins, then any ask, then a granted approve; errors, timeouts, invalid results, expired or out-of-scope grants ask; managed requirements and host denials stay final; a delegated approval shows a native notice
decisions.native: PermissionRequest hooks can approve but run after policy shortcuts and cannot force a prompt

decisions.decision: Runtime tool definitions
decisions.observe: calls to defined tools reach the `api.dynamicTools` handler as `{name, arguments}`
decisions.alter: `tools.define` adds or replaces a model-visible tool and `tools.undefine` removes it
decisions.timing: at the next model request
decisions.ownership: mod: tool definitions and results; host: schema validation, exposure and admission
decisions.limits: 64 per mod; names distinct from the mod's static tools; native event and tool callbacks only; cleared when the mod reloads
decisions.native: no native equivalent

decisions.decision: Tool-output feedback
decisions.observe: `tool_output` with bounded text and byte count after any interceptor result
decisions.alter: observers append up to 4 KiB each (16 KiB total) of feedback
decisions.timing: after the handler returns, before upstream truncation and history recording
decisions.ownership: mod: appended feedback; host: call id, status, the retrievable original and the ledger hashes
decisions.limits: handlers see the first 48 KiB plus a 16 KiB tail; feedback extends any output by at most 16 KiB; image and audio items appear as markers
decisions.native: PostToolUse hooks can add feedback but cannot keep a retrievable original

decisions.decision: Tool-call batch merge
decisions.observe: `tool_batch` with the parallel-safe calls of one response
decisions.alter: merge several calls into one call of a mod-registered tool
decisions.timing: after the response's calls are known, before dispatch
decisions.ownership: mod: which calls merge; host: admission, approvals, per-call results and attribution
decisions.limits: merged calls run once under a synthetic id; results fan out by call id and missing results become errors; dispatch is unchanged without an owner
decisions.native: no native equivalent

decisions.decision: Model-visible tool descriptions
decisions.observe: `intercept('tool_specs')` with the route and the model-visible tools; `tools.list` with every tool's original and effective description and schema, hidden and deferred state, and the declarations generated from it
decisions.alter: drop, defer behind tool search or re-describe tools; interceptors compose in continuation order; execution identity is unchanged
decisions.timing: when the tool router is built for a turn
decisions.ownership: mod: descriptions and visibility; host: execution, schemas it accepts and admission
decisions.limits: a handler can only drop, defer or re-describe tools it was given and must call `next`; a model without tool search keeps deferred tools visible; calls still pass through the tool interceptors; the final arguments of a rewritten call, or of a call to a tool whose schema was replaced, are validated against the original schema (`tool_arguments_invalid`); `tools.list` is bounded to 512 tools, 4096-character descriptions and 16 KiB schemas
decisions.native: no native equivalent

decisions.decision: Channels, process events and workspace watches
decisions.observe: `channel`, `process_event`, `timer` and external `workspace_change`
decisions.alter: `events.publish` to a namespaced channel; `workspace.watch` bounded paths; `events.schedule` and `events.cancel` keyed timers for the calling mod
decisions.timing: background delivery at safe points
decisions.ownership: mod: subscriptions and payloads; host: namespaces, queues, watch roots and debounce
decisions.limits: 256 events / 1 MiB per subscriber, drop-oldest with counts; 16 watches and 16 timers per mod (configurable); timers from 100 ms to 24 h never start a turn; watches and timers end when the mod unloads or changes; protected and ignored paths excluded; at most ten timer deliveries per second per owner/thread, coalescing repeated pending keys
decisions.native: no native equivalent

decisions.decision: Credential profiles, secrets and route selection
decisions.observe: `credentials.list` without secret material
decisions.alter: `credentials.request` opens native enroll, refresh or remove flows; `routes.select` picks a configured route for the next request or thread; `sidecars.start` receives the caller's own origin-bound secrets
decisions.timing: user contexts for credential flows; next safe request boundary for routes
decisions.ownership: mod: which profile or route; host: storage, sign-in, injection and expiry
decisions.limits: secrets and tokens never reach the mod runtime or the model; secrets are listed to and removable by their owner only; a missing or expired credential blocks the request
decisions.native: no native equivalent

decisions.decision: Turn-activity ledger
decisions.observe: `turns.activity` for the current thread: outcomes, tool calls, processes and file changes
decisions.alter: no; turns.abort accepts a named current-turn cancellation only from user/event callbacks, refusing stale turns or queued input
decisions.timing: recorded only while an enabled mod's source calls `turns.activity`
decisions.ownership: host: records; mod: reads
decisions.limits: turns before recording started read as unavailable; per-turn lists are bounded and marked truncated
decisions.native: no native equivalent

decisions.decision: Layout, notifications, composer and built-in actions
decisions.observe: `component_event` (including ordered, batched key and paste input from focused `keys: true` panes and documents), `view` and `focus`
decisions.alter: `terminal.notify`, `terminal.show_thread`, `sessions.ports` listeners, confirmed `terminal.import_file` with thread/package lifetime, bounded `terminal.image_sample`, `composer.read`/`write` and `builtins.invoke {action}` key actions
decisions.timing: user commands; composer writes and imports from user contexts
decisions.ownership: mod: content; host: rendering, focus, confirmation and rate limits
decisions.limits: notifications honor terminal settings and a 2 s rate limit; approval key actions and authority commands are refused; imports are 8 MiB maximum; image samples are PNG/JPEG, 4096px per dimension, 120 by 60 RGBA samples; package imports survive config/thread changes but remain repository, owner and exact-source bound
decisions.native: hooks cannot draw, notify, edit the composer or invoke built-ins

decisions.decision: Package controls
decisions.observe: `packages.list` (every store selection with the session's effective, pending, failed and quarantined state), `packages.index` (curated index search) and `packages.preview`
decisions.alter: `packages.apply` installs, updates, removes, rolls back, enables, disables or re-trusts an edited selection after a native confirmation; `packages.reload` revalidates every selection; `settings.write` saves schema-checked settings for the caller, or with `packages` for another mod, and redraws at once
decisions.timing: user contexts; changes apply at the next boundary
decisions.ownership: mod: request; host: previewed plan, confirmation, trust and lock
decisions.limits: the confirmed plan is applied as previewed; updates resolve dependencies from their index and preview added grants; a changed package, lock or selection refuses; `/omd` stays the native recovery
decisions.native: no native equivalent

decisions.decision: Composer mention completion
decisions.observe: `completion` with the query and upstream candidates
decisions.alter: reorder, filter or add workspace-relative paths; suggest a mod command's arguments from the mod that registered the command, else the owner
decisions.timing: each `@` query result
decisions.ownership: mod: ranking; host: the popup, insertion and stale-result filtering
decisions.limits: 200 items; relative paths only; without an owner upstream ranking is unchanged
decisions.native: no native equivalent

decisions.decision: Opening links, images and native prompts
decisions.observe: no
decisions.alter: `terminal.open` for http(s) URLs or inert files; `terminal.prompt` asks the user to confirm, type text or choose among options (single, multiple or with an Other answer); `image` components
decisions.timing: after a native confirmation for opening
decisions.ownership: mod: request; host: confirmation, file-type allowlist and rendering
decisions.limits: opened files must be documents or images; prompts are answered only by the user; images render as truecolor cells, alt text under `NO_COLOR`
decisions.native: no native equivalent

decisions.decision: Interactive shell panes
decisions.observe: `terminal.pty` read returns the screen text
decisions.alter: start (user context, confirmed) a sandboxed shell or named program, then write, read and stop it; panes render in `terminal` components
decisions.timing: while the pane runs
decisions.ownership: mod: session and input; host: sandbox, PTY, rendering and key routing
decisions.limits: four panes per mod and sixteen in all; workspace writes need `fs.write` and are named in the confirmation; the session sandbox without network and a scratch HOME; panes render only in views the owner contributes to and stop when it unloads; Ctrl+] leaves a focused pane
decisions.native: no native equivalent

decisions.decision: One-shot model completions and conversation forks
decisions.observe: no
decisions.alter: `model.complete` runs one tool-less worker turn with system, context, output schema, effort, output-cap and cache-mark options; `model.fork` runs it on a snapshot of the conversation, returning requested tool calls unexecuted; a cache mark sets a prefix-derived `prompt_cache_key` and an `x-omd-cache-breakpoint` for provider transports, and `cache` sums reads and writes
decisions.timing: event, tool, timer and channel callbacks and terminal commands in the session's process
decisions.ownership: mod: prompt, options and route; host: route grants, admission, settlement, interception and cancellation
decisions.limits: prompt ≤ 8 KiB, system ≤ 8 KiB, context ≤ 32 KiB; ≤ 300 s; `agents` (and `sessions` for forks); `lead` only for a lead route listing the mod; a response cut at `max_output_tokens` returns `incomplete` with its streamed text
decisions.native: no native equivalent

decisions.decision: SDK helpers over host views
decisions.observe: `api.session()` reads `session.info`; `api.usage.summarize` reads a `model_response`
decisions.alter: `api.time` sleeps without holding the runtime and schedules generation-owned timers; `api.fs`, `api.classify` and `api.usage` wrap workspace, model and usage views
decisions.timing: inside the calling callback
decisions.ownership: mod: when to call; host: the underlying operations and their grants
decisions.limits: sleep ≤ 60 s; timers 100 ms to 24 h under the host timer limits; classification needs an explicit route
decisions.native: no native equivalent

decisions.decision: Provider-billed routes and late settlement
decisions.observe: `model_response` reports `provider_reported` or `unsettled` cost for provider-billed requests
decisions.alter: a service grant's own mod settles one unsettled provider-billed request with `ledger.settle`
decisions.timing: after the provider settles; any callback that may call host operations
decisions.ownership: mod: when and what the provider charged; host: admission, request identity, ownership checks and the ledger
decisions.limits: zero reservation; one settlement per request; only the route owner's requests; last 1024 unsettled requests per process
decisions.native: no native equivalent

decisions.decision: Model-bound history view
decisions.observe: `history` with a bounded view of the request items
decisions.alter: drop, replace or insert items in the request only; replace message text (dropping images), tool outputs and call arguments
decisions.timing: each model request, before admission accounting
decisions.ownership: mod: which items; host: validation, transcript and provenance
decisions.limits: the transcript is unchanged; reasoning items are only dropped together with, and never separated from, the item they precede; call/output pairs stay whole; the current input is kept; failures keep the original history
decisions.native: no native equivalent

decisions.decision: Store-time rewriting of persisted history text
decisions.observe: `history_persist` sees each batch's message, tool call, tool output, event-copy and compaction texts before the rollout is written
decisions.alter: change entry text only, for redaction; ids, call ids, roles, order and count are fixed
decisions.timing: synchronously before each rollout write; the live conversation keeps the original until the thread is reloaded
decisions.ownership: mod: entry text; host: entry selection, chunking, provenance and the rollout
decisions.limits: no host operations; 96 KiB of text per callback, longer texts split across entries with the same index; reasoning, images, encrypted content and realtime transcripts are not offered; a failing required interceptor persists a placeholder
decisions.native: no native equivalent

decisions.decision: Granted durable rewriting of the persisted transcript
decisions.observe: `app.request thread/rewrite` without `expectedRevision` reads the revision and rows; `thread/rewritten` reports each new revision
decisions.alter: insert, append, replace, reorder and delete message and paired tool call/output rows as one revision, or undo the latest revision
decisions.timing: idle threads only; the thread is unloaded, rewritten and reloaded, and clients re-page turns and items
decisions.ownership: user: the hash-bound, revocable `history_write` grant; mod: which rows; host: revision CAS, pairing, provenance, kept originals, revision log and its broker anchor
decisions.limits: current thread and threads the mod started; paginated persisted threads; rows before the newest compaction and opaque items are frozen, reasoning is delete-only; replacements keep role or call id, inserted call ids are new; rewritten items drop execution, delivery and tool inventory metadata; at most 256 edits
decisions.native: upstream `thread/revert` only truncates at a turn boundary

decisions.decision: Structured HTTP, external files, environment metadata and MCP lifecycle
decisions.observe: `http.request`/`http.open`/`http.read` responses with redacted headers and redirect hops; `workspace.read`/`list`/`stat` with `root`; `environment.read` values of declared non-secret names; status `access` and the session's `mod-access.jsonl` receipts
decisions.alter: send requests to `http_access.origins` with an opaque `credential` profile attached only for its enrolled origin; change files under writable `fs_access.roots` with expected versions; connect or disconnect `mcp_servers` on the mod's thread through the engine's MCP refresh; environment.set changes only caller/source/thread-local future child environment, with declared-name grants
decisions.timing: lifecycle, interceptor, timer and channel callbacks in the session; external roots and `environment.read` also from commands
decisions.ownership: user: the hash-bound `http`, `fs.external` and `mcp` grants, their expiry and `omd-mod revoke`; host: origin, redirect and root checks under the actual caller, deadlines, cancellation, stream and server teardown at reload, disable, revoke or expiry, receipts
decisions.limits: bodies 128 KiB per request result, 1 MiB per request body, 4 streams per mod closed after 60 s idle, 5 redirects each re-checked, no raw tokens; roots must be canonical and outside the workspace, mod stores and credential locations; MCP command servers run as the user like any configured server and their tools pass normal tool approvals
decisions.native: no native equivalent

decisions.decision: Command and configuration metadata, execution and changes
decisions.observe: `commands.list`/`commands.describe` rows (owner, hidden, argument hint, immediate, protected); `config.describe` rows (label, redacted value, source, version, editable, managed, secret); the `config_change` event with original and effective values
decisions.alter: `command_list` and `config_list` interceptors hide, relabel or hint ordinary rows; `command` interceptors rewrite arguments, transform results or deny; `config_set` interceptors transform or deny a value; `commands.invoke` runs a built-in or mod command and returns its result; `config.set` writes an editable row
decisions.timing: command popup and inventory, typed and invoked commands, `config.set`, `settings.write`
decisions.ownership: mod: metadata, transforms and refusals; host: protected commands, managed and secret rows, the writable-key allowlist, confirmation of Codex writes, version-checked writes and recovery
decisions.limits: protected commands (`/omd`, `/quit`, `/approvals`, `/status`, ...) bypass `command` interceptors and stay visible; managed and secret rows are immutable and values never include secrets; non-immediate mod commands are refused during a turn; at most 4 nested `commands.invoke` runs; a failed list chain keeps the native rows
decisions.native: hooks cannot list, rewrite or refuse commands or settings

decisions.decision: Explicitly authorized mod admission and namespace policy
decisions.observe: each other active package's id, version, digest, source, capabilities, dependencies and services at load
decisions.alter: refuse a package (`{deny}`) or withhold host namespaces inside `policy.namespaces` (`{withhold}`); an outer handler may only tighten the decision beneath it
decisions.timing: every reload; decisions are cached by package and policy digest, so changed content is judged again
decisions.ownership: user: the hash-bound `policy` grant; host: native admission first, the policy mods and their dependencies are never judged, dependents of refused packages are refused, withheld namespaces fail with `capability_withheld`
decisions.limits: no host operations during admission; a failing or faulted required policy refuses the other packages with `admission_policy_unavailable` until the policy mod is disabled or reloaded in `/omd`; policy cannot grant capabilities, change managed policy, broker grants or authority operations
decisions.native: no native equivalent

decisions.decision: Agent definitions, offers, spawn interception and session-wide agent inventory
decisions.observe: every model, mod and engine-started agent of the session: parent, origin, owner, definition and source digest, status, turns, visible answers, duration, usage and failure or cancel reason (`agents.inventory`, the `agent` event)
decisions.alter: register `<mod>/<name>` definitions with `api.agent`, offer them to models, drop or re-describe offers (`agent_offers`), and transform (definition, prompt, model, effort, session-root cwd, narrowed tools) or deny every spawn (`agent_spawn`)
decisions.timing: offers at every tool plan; spawn interception before the native or mod spawn runs; inventory and events as agents start, finish turns and stop
decisions.ownership: host: configured role names win, route admission, worker limits and the parent's permissions are re-checked after transforms, definition tools are enforced on the child; observing an agent never grants message or cancel authority
decisions.limits: 8 definitions per mod; cwd or tool changes need a definition; native definitions use lead routes on the thread's own provider; 64 finished inventory records; usage is summed from model_response reports and marked partial when unpriced
decisions.native: native `spawn_agent` roles; mod definitions use the same role layer

decisions.decision: Explicitly granted peer-session messaging
decisions.observe: live peer sessions where a package accepts messages (`peers.list`), inbound messages as untrusted data with host-stamped sender identity (`peer_message`) and delivery receipts (`peer_receipt`)
decisions.alter: send messages (`peers.send`), transform or refuse them outbound (`peer_send`) and inbound (`peer_receive`)
decisions.timing: delivered within about a second while the recipient session runs; receipts follow delivery, refusal, failure, expiry or a closed recipient
decisions.ownership: user: the hash-bound, expiring and revocable `peers` grant with `peer_access`; host: broker countersignature, replay and expiry checks, both sides' project scope, mailbox limits
decisions.limits: fails closed without the deployed authority broker; same-store sessions only; 64 KiB data, 1 s to 1 h TTL, 64 waiting messages per recipient; receiving never starts a turn or lends authority
decisions.native: no native equivalent

decisions.decision: Opt-in attributed autonomous prompt queues and turn continuation
decisions.observe: the caller's queued entries, turns started and settled spend (`turns.queued`) and queue outcomes (`turn_queue`)
decisions.alter: queue prompts that start turns when the thread is idle (`turns.queue`, `turns.dequeue`) and continue a lead turn the model would end (`turn_stop` answering `{continue}`)
decisions.timing: a queued entry starts one second after the thread goes idle, after typed input; continuations run at the engine's stop point
decisions.ownership: user: the hash-bound, expiring and revocable `autonomous` grant with `autonomy` limits; Esc pauses the thread's queues until the user types; host: provenance on the message, prompt event and input interceptors, route and permissions unchanged
decisions.limits: max_queued, max_turns, max_continuations (4 at most per turn) and optional spend_microusd; stale sources, expired grants and passed deadlines drop entries; continuations cannot pass verifiers or submit receipts
decisions.native: upstream Stop hooks and the thread queue are not mod-reachable

decisions.decision: Per-occurrence compaction control
decisions.observe: every manual and automatic local, remote and token-budget compaction of the lead thread with its trigger, reason, phase, budget and a bounded history view (`compaction`), and the outcome (`compaction_end`)
decisions.alter: the local summarization prompt, the host's result after it compacts, or the occurrence itself: skip, defer, a summary or a validated kept-and-inserted history (`compaction` interceptors)
decisions.timing: after PreCompact hooks and before the provider call; a result replacement runs before the history is installed
decisions.ownership: host: hard-limit refusal (`compaction_required`), size estimate, tool-call and reasoning pairing, persistence as the normal compaction checkpoint; mods: the decision and any summarizer call they make on their own routes
decisions.limits: 1,024-item view with 128 KiB of previews, 64 KiB summaries, 256 KiB history edits; one host compaction per occurrence
decisions.native: upstream PreCompact/PostCompact hooks observe or stop compaction but cannot replace it

decisions.decision: Revision-bound drafts, ghost suggestions and edit interception
decisions.observe: draft revisions, cursor, selection and attachment resources (`composer.read`), changes and suggestion outcomes (`composer`), submitted draft context (`input`) and prompt expansion by identity (`prompt_expanded`)
decisions.alter: the draft at a known revision (`composer.write`), one ghost suggestion (`composer.suggest`) and every mod write or native fill (`composer_edit`)
decisions.timing: writes apply only at the revision they name; suggestions clear on any edit, turn start, dialog or owner reload; change events are debounced to 250 ms
decisions.ownership: user: acceptance (move-right at the draft end or a click), dismissal and submission; host: revisions, owner-bound attachment resources and revocation; mods: suggestion and formatting policy
decisions.limits: 64 KiB edits, 4 KiB suggestions, 8 MiB image resources; no write submits
decisions.native: upstream composer offers no programmatic draft API

decisions.decision: Lifecycle seams and the classic-hook adapter
decisions.observe: settled tool batches, instruction, skill and attachment loads, thread settings, worktrees and elicitation results (`tool_batch_end`, `instructions_loaded`, `thread_settings`, `worktree`, `elicitation_result`)
decisions.alter: answer MCP form elicitations without secret fields (`elicitation`) and continue a failed turn (`turn_stop` with `outcome: 'error'`); `api.hook` maps all 33 classic hook names onto events and interceptors
decisions.timing: after the native step completes; elicitation interceptors run before the user is asked
decisions.ownership: user: secret entry, URL and user-verification elicitations; host: redaction, required-field validation and lead-thread scope
decisions.limits: 64 KiB elicitation answers; event-backed classic hooks are optional deliveries
decisions.native: upstream hooks cover a subset of events with external commands and cannot answer elicitations
evidence: node:classic hooks map onto native events and interceptors with glob and negated matchers

decisions.decision: User-captured prompts delivered as the user
decisions.observe: consent and delivery state (`prompts.status`)
decisions.alter: submit exactly the content the user consented to, once, as a new turn or steering (`prompts.consent` in user contexts, `prompts.submit`, `prompts.revoke`)
decisions.timing: submission runs on the terminal's own path; delivery is confirmed when the message with the client id is committed, including on resume
decisions.ownership: user: consent per captured, edited or joined prompt; host: single-use content-bound consents per thread, outside mod state and forks
decisions.limits: 61,440-byte prompts, 8 images, 64 pending consents per mod and thread
decisions.native: upstream queued messages are local to the terminal and not mod-reachable

composition.rule: Activation and dispatch order is deterministic: declared dependencies first, then mod ID ascending. The same order is used for every event, tool listing, command listing and contract listing, and is published in `omd-mod status` as `order`.

`api.on` is middleware: observers compose, may veto (`deny`), contribute additive context, and on the current API contribute bounded terminal patches. `api.replace` is exclusive: one mod per replacement point, claimed at activation. A non-null `routing` or `compaction` decision without replacement fails visibly; older terminal observers also remain observe-only. A context replacer drops observer fragments with a notice naming both sides.

Interceptors compose as one continuation chain per operation: ordinary handlers wrap required ones; each tier follows explicit `before`/`after`, then consumers outside their dependencies, then mod ID and registration order, and a cycle disables its mods. A failure before `next` skips the handler, after `next` keeps the downstream result, a `.catch` handler may answer instead, and a required handler's failure or unavailability fails the operation closed. A reload lets running handlers finish.

Every mod's terminal patch composes in dependency order. Wrappers contain one slot; exclusive fields (layout, backdrop, panels, header, footer, placeholder, replaced sites, keys, glyphs and the status budget) go to the first claimant and each later claim is reported in `terminal.conflicts` with its field, owner, rejected mod and origin; a patch that breaks the composed view's limits is rejected without leaking any of its fields.

Render hooks compose as one continuation chain per native component instance in interceptor order, so unrelated wrappers nest; each sees the props the hook before it passed on, the native drawing appears at most once, and a failing or invalid hook is skipped with the input it received.

Contested exclusive claims — a replacement point, a workflow contract ID or a namespaced tool name — are detected before activation and disable every claimant with an error naming all of them. No claimant silently wins, and unrelated mods keep running.

`requires` lists up to four other mod IDs. A dependency that is absent, disabled or itself failed disables the dependent chain before activation; a cycle disables every mod in it. Both are reported per mod and neither stops the host.

Discovery reports project packages shadowing user packages by ID. Trust and activation stay explicit and per path: each selection records its scope, a project-scoped selection takes precedence over a user-scoped one with the same ID, the shadowed selection is recorded and not activated, and the two scopes never share mod state. Two selections of one ID in the same scope both fail closed.

A mod that throws while activating, loses a capability, or is rejected by the store is disabled alone with a source-located error. Every other mod keeps running, its owned agents and services are cleaned up, and a healthy mod keeps its terminal view with the error panel inserted above it. The failure is reported to the user through that panel, `omd-mod status` and the persisted `mod-status.json`; a failure inside a callback is additionally reported to the model for that turn.

Reload happens at a native turn boundary. The initial load isolates per selection; a later reload is transactional — if any enabled selection fails, the previous eligible set stays loaded and the reason is shown once. Stale generations are refused, in-flight work keeps the source it started with, and settings and state survive an edit.

Every callback is cancellable. Cancellation discards the callback's state write, cancels its owned agents and services, records the turn outcome, and leaves the terminal usable; an explicit reload recovers the mod.
Mod tool progress streams into the live panel during the call and leaves one labelled activity line when it completes; replayed host calls never duplicate an update.

Registration, payload, context, progress, host-call and execution budgets are enforced by the host, not by the mod: 16 mods, 16 tools and 16 commands per mod, 1 KiB context fragments under a 6 KiB aggregate, 32 host calls and 32 progress updates per callback, a per-evaluation `hook_budget_ms` with a separate 5 s total for the whole callback including host-call replays, and 64 KiB state.

First-party mods use the published API only. `omd_workflow` declares ordinary capabilities, carries no private symbol and no per-mod Rust patch, and runs under the same package and conformance rules as outside packages.

unsupported: Native workflow-contract enforcement, permissions, spending grants, cancellation, provider credentials, workspace integrity, durable evidence and final acceptance.
Unbounded history rewriting or editing of reasoning and call/output pairs, arbitrary compaction engines, custom prompts for provider-side remote compaction.
Raw terminal escape sequences, arbitrary widgets or DOM/canvas access, overriding approval key bindings, transcript mutation, and clipboard authorization bypass.
Arbitrary provider compatibility, runtime imports other than adapter-declared aliases, and any second scheduler or uncontrolled execution path.
Mod-to-mod calls: `requires` declares presence and order only; mods never call each other or share state.
